verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, with local and cloud base URLs, curl examples, a cloud API reference, and official Python and JavaScript libraries. It also offers OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and community users report building bots and products on it. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and full rather than subset OpenAI API compatibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
Python library and JavaScript library — use Ollama from your application.
